reviews.title: What did you do???
reviews.text: Can’t sort to see the last few items I added on top without categories.  This list is now worthless to me.

reviews.title: Over complex
reviews.text:
The program is too detailed. Remembering past notes notes is kludgy. If I write a note I want it to be unique imagine if you couldn’t throw away old postits. 
Same on lists. I don’t want an item “milk” to be different than “2 milk” in history.

reviews.title: Can't use with my Apple watch after the latest update
reviews.text: My watch is very 8.8.2 and will no longer work with anylist.  I'll be canceling my premium version.

reviews.title: Too complicated to share
reviews.text: Making a shared list with someone is too complicated. You can access some of my contacts but not all, I can’t change that setting, I can’t access a contact who I have shared lists with multiple times? Absolutely ridiculous. Sort your app to add friends or something, until that I’m deleting. Useless app.

reviews.title: So sad
reviews.text: Brilliant App but such a chore to open it. No icon for homepage and have to start a lengthy process from original email to access it
